articles.headline: Emotional All-Pro LB Campbell shoulders blame for Lions' loss
articles.description: Jack Campbell fought back tears while reflecting on Detroit's poor defensive effort in Thursday night's loss in Buffalo.

articles.headline: Bills celebrate new Highmark Stadium in style with big win
articles.description: The Bills threw a heck of a housewarming party for their new Highmark Stadium on Thursday, launching fireworks to open the night and then piling up points in a 41-31 victory over the Detroit Lions that felt more dominant than the final score indicated.

articles.headline: Josh Allen opens the Bills' new stadium with a 5-TD outing in a 41-31 win over the Lions
articles.description: — Forget the official name of the Buffalo Bills' new stadium. It’s Josh Allen’s house.
